data.exact_reserve_text: An unfavorable run-off deviation (prior accident years' deterioration) of $121m for Syndicate 2003 was experienced during the year driven from various lines of business. The most significant contributors towards the adverse experience were London Wholesale Property ($58m), Energy ($32m) and US Workers' Compensation ($18m) accounts due to unfavourable claims experience.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2017 with gross claims outstanding of $4,143.5m. During 2017 there was an adverse prior-year development of $121.0m (strengthening), driven principally by London Wholesale Property ($58m), Energy ($32m) and US Workers' Compensation ($18m). The 2017 underwriting result was further hit by a series of natural catastrophe events (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, the Mexico earthquake and California Wildfires) which produced gross losses of $1,015m and, after reinsurance and reinstatement premiums, a net loss of $290m.
raw_causal_phrases: An unfavorable run-off deviation (prior accident years' deterioration) of $121m for Syndicate 2003 was experienced during the year driven from various lines of business.

The most significant contributors towards the adverse experience were London Wholesale Property ($58m), Energy ($32m) and US Workers' Compensation ($18m) accounts due to unfavourable claims experience.

The underwriting result in 2017 was significantly affected by losses relating to the catastrophe events in the second half of the year: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria in August and September; the Mexico earthquake in September; and the California Wildfires in November and December. Collectively, these represented gross losses to the Syndicate of $1,015m.
Net of all reinsurance and related reinstatement premiums, the total losses on these events was $290m.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Technical Provisions reconciliation (note 12, As at 1 January 2017). Prior year development taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative (stated as an unfavorable run-off deviation of $121m). The movement note presents the $121m as a gross prior-year deterioration without an explicit label 'gross' versus 'net' but is presented in the movement note context and has been treated as gross per the report wording. All amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD) and converted to millions. Page references are based on the report's notes as provided in the document.
